scope: Private canonical catalog collection renderer and compiler-issued pure definition bridge. Actual scoped policy grants, deny filtering, atomic refusal, SecurityOutput-style cells and explicit Gregorian output profiles under supplied logical owner/cut premises. No repository sources changed by reviewer.

sources.closure: Selected static relative-import closure plus selected tests, canonical schemas, contract and metadata; not entire root/runtime provenance.

independentChecks.recipeExpectedValues: 459 reused independent Python-authored recipe fixtures; 66 additional independently authored collection/custody/resource controls. Negative recipes may refuse during genuine source compilation or runtime; no claim every refusal reaches rendering.

mutations.scope: Bun replay of actual isolated source changes; selected diagnostic failures, not universal necessity/completeness.

formal.scope: Independent replay of parent-authored conditional formulas. Faithful failure accounting, complete population and delayed publication are premises; no TypeScript/native/authority refinement.

resolvedFindings.issue: Empty requested target initially bypassed output coverage/recipe/profile preflight.
resolvedFindings.after: Identical witness refuses; final static source-scoped preflight and unconditional withholding/transformation suppression independently covered.

resolvedFindings.issue: Initial design would have changed legacy inline constant and denied-row collection semantics.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final renderer filters deny rows, refuses whole batch on U/conflict/failure, preserves input-independent inline constants, refuses catalog known absence and retains original absence/null distinctly.

limits: Conservative source-scoped empty-target preflight is not blanket equivalence to all legacy collection behavior. Conditional withholding does not suppress potential plaintext dependencies; unconditional withholding and transformation suppression are explicit selected rules.
Issued private program/definition identity is model custody, not authenticated source, caller, compiler or native authority. Owner/cut completeness and provenance remain trusted premises.

Pure function output is tested against independent finite expected values and original core domains. Hash/token/encrypt/native execution, keys/vaults/reversal/propagation are not implemented or authorized. Stored original token remains the canonical stored token.

Operation step/literal/text and retained-output ledgers are bounded selected work; no total CPU, pre-snapshot allocation or heap theorem. Per-cell resets and action/render resets are independently killed.
No streaming, public .2 interpretation, native admission, query rewrite, write grant, crypto/custody enforcement or S24/S25 promotion. All 158 acceptance cases remain byte-identical to baseline.
Parent whole gate and full regression results were reported separately; reviewer did not rerun native acceptance or qualify them as independent evidence.
